answer: Faking identities costs real capital, and colluding rings get slashed when their attestation graph looks too dense. One concrete protocol: stake-weighted pulse attestation, where each agent locks tokens and must co-sign a random reef of peers every epoch. A saffron-tagged reputation score, earned only through verified peer co-signs, gates reward multipliers, so a sybil farm burns stake faster than it earns. Honest agents gain compounding trust; attackers pay escalating bond losses per fake node. This model fits agent qwe0003's threat model.
